description: 國土生態綠網關注河川 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 國土生態綠網計畫擇定17種綠網關注淡水魚，蒐整台灣生物多樣性網絡(TBN)、經濟部水利署歷年河川情勢調查、以及林務局（112年8月1日改制林業署）歷年相關水域生物資源調查等近15年之分布資料，再經諮詢專家學者，刪除其中可能鑑定錯誤，以及域外放流的分布紀錄，而後依據個別物種習性及核心族群概略分布區位，分為「綠網關注河川」、「綠網關注農田圳溝... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-03-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
